capabilities.name: Agent task delegation
capabilities.description: Assigns validated task requests to policy-approved candidates through an injected dispatch adapter, with bounded candidate enumeration and deterministic selection.
limitations: Candidate resolver and dispatch adapter are integration seams; no authenticated network delivery or remote identity verification is implemented.
Candidate limit defaults to 256; excess candidate enumeration rejects the task.
Requester identity and candidate capability claims are not independently authenticated or attested.

capabilities.name: Task submission idempotency
capabilities.description: Returns the existing task for an identical idempotency key and rejects conflicting key reuse within the process lifetime.

capabilities.name: Dispatch acknowledgement binding
capabilities.description: Binds acknowledgements and completion to the exact dispatch reference and selected agent.

capabilities.name: Bounded retry and lease recovery
capabilities.description: Retries dispatch or failed/expired attempts within explicit attempt and lease bounds.

explicit_non_capabilities: production AIX codec or adapter integration
proof of candidate identity, health or capability implementation
